title: 공기청정기 버튼과 화면 읽기: 공기가 어때요?
objective: By the end, you can read the words on an air purifier screen to find the air quality, fan speed and timer, and choose the right button for what you need.
summary: Learners read the buttons and display of a home air purifier to see the air quality and set the machine.
note: The machine on this sheet is an example. Button names and steps can be different on your machine, so check its manual.

task.title: Read and set the machine
task.line: Use the buttons and screen words on page 1 to answer each question.

items.text: Turns the machine on or off.
The machine changes the fan speed by itself.
Makes the machine quiet and the lights dark for the night.
Press it to change how strong the wind is.
These are the fan speed levels.
The machine turns off after the hours you choose.
When it is on, the other buttons do not work.
The number on the screen shows how much fine dust is in the air.
This word tells you how clean the air is now.
This light comes on when the filter is old.

sections.heading: How to read the screen
paragraphs: Sample screen: 미세먼지 (PM2.5) 12㎍/㎥ 좋음 | 자동 | 예약 4시간
Read left to right. The number is the amount of fine dust, and the word after it (좋음) tells you if the air is clean. Next is the mode (자동). Last, 예약 4시간 means the machine turns off in 4 hours.

steps.en: take the plastic off the new filter
put in the new filter and close the cover
press and hold the filter button to reset the light

exercises: Read the screen and answer in English (화면: 미세먼지 52㎍/㎥ 나쁨 | 풍량 강 | 예약 3시간): ① 지금 공기가 어때요? ② 풍량은 어떻게 돼 있어요? ③ 언제 꺼져요?
Which button do you press? Choose from 수면, 자동, 예약, 잠금: ① 이제 자요. 조용하면 좋겠어요. ② 바람을 기계가 알아서 바꾸면 좋겠어요. ③ 한 시간 후에 꺼지면 좋겠어요. ④ 아이가 자꾸 버튼을 눌러요.
Read the screen and write Yes or No (화면: 미세먼지 12㎍/㎥ 좋음 | 자동 | 잠금): ① 지금 공기가 나빠요. ② 기계가 풍량을 정해요. ③ 지금 버튼을 누르면 바로 바뀌어요.
Fill in the blank with one word from page 1: 화면에 '필터 교체'가 나왔어요. 새 ____를 사야 해요.
Fill in the blank with 약, 중, or 강: 먼지가 아주 많아요. 바람이 가장 세면 좋겠어요. 풍량을 ____(으)로 하세요.
answers: ① Bad (나쁨) ② High (강) ③ In 3 hours
① 수면 ② 자동 ③ 예약 ④ 잠금
① No ② Yes ③ No
